state_bc.method: MLP + geometric feature engineering (behind_proj, lateral, approach distance, push direction)
state_bc.note: Proves the unified task is learnable from state alone

vla.ablation_design: Single model evaluated with correct/swapped/zeroed language; vision-only baseline independently trained
vla.note: Needs significantly more data (>1000 episodes) and/or larger model

rl.method: PPO (Actor-Critic + GAE + BC pre-training + expert-guided exploration)
rl.note: BC pre-training reaches 40%, but PPO fine-tuning partially destabilizes policy. Hyperparameter-sensitive.

action_chunking.method: Minimal Action-Chunking Policy (K-frame Transformer, lang-conditioned, temporal ensembling, no CVAE)
action_chunking.note: TBD — not yet evaluated for closed-loop success

diffusion.method: Minimal Diffusion Policy (DDPM, action horizon, lang-conditioned, deterministic eval)
diffusion.note: TBD — not yet evaluated for closed-loop success

notes: Expert baseline achieves ~100% success rate (50 random seeds), improved from 65% via three-phase heuristic.
State-BC achieves 90% success, proving the unified task is learnable from structured state input.
VLA shows 0% success rate — tiny model (CNN+MLP) needs significantly more data and/or larger model.
PPO achieves 10-20% success rate (500 episodes); BC pre-training alone reaches 40%.
World Model prediction error grows with horizon (H=1: 0.07, H=10: 0.56), as expected.
VLA ablation framework is correct (single-model, same-episode, multi-condition) but the tiny model has not learned strong language conditioning.
Selection accuracy near 50% across VLA conditions indicates the model has not yet learned to discriminate cubes by language.
These are teaching-level results — small models, limited data — intended to show algorithm differences, not production-grade performance.
